headline: 9 on-chain accounts catalogued on Solana (stake pool + 8 associated accounts); spl-stake-pool program independently audited 9 times; no JagPool-owned GitHub or protocol-specific audit; token mint address discrepancy flagged for downstream resolution.

findings.text: Solscan confirmed stake pool account jagPCXWPBwoah9K4PxzHoh8z7aSru4Vbxq7GKUeEzgY exists on Solana mainnet. Solflare surfaces token address jag58eRBC1c88LaAsRPspTMvoKJPbnzw9p9fREzHqyV as the official jagSOL mint; Solana Compass lists a different Pool Mint jag7A2z4QNacNi61AXpyRiyUppx5GeLbGEKAapuKCRs — discrepancy recorded for downstream resolution.

Official docs at docs.jagpool.xyz contain no dedicated deployed-contracts page. All contract addresses were sourced from the third-party Solana Compass stake-pool statistics page. deployed_contracts_doc set to null; Solana Compass page cited as secondary source.

No JagPool-specific audit PDFs linked in protocol.audit_links. The JagPool website FAQ references spl.solana.com/stake-pool#security-audits, which lists 9 audits of the underlying spl-stake-pool program by Quantstamp, Neodyme (×4), Kudelski, OtterSec, and Halborn (×2), all against the canonical SPoo1Ku8WFXoNDMHPsrGSTSG1Y47rzgn41SLUNakuHy program — not JagPool's own manager/staker/off-chain logic.

protocol.github is null; no JagPool-owned GitHub repository was discovered. The docs site links to a Docusaurus edit URL pointing to facebook/docusaurus (template artifact, not JagPool's repo). No deployment artifacts, broadcast logs, or address indexes could be walked.
Protocol operates on Solana only (single chain). No multi-chain enumeration required.

The stake pool's Validator List Storage Account (jagQtbgkyixDtJmbTQDKKPTXp7PvKKroLDs1BVJkEJt) serves as the factory-equivalent listing all delegated validators. Solana Compass shows 1 active validator in Epoch 702 with near-zero stake (0.1 SOL total), suggesting this may be a testnet or recently-launched/emptied pool instance. Full validator enumeration deferred to dedicated ingestion; cap notice recorded.

Role taxonomy applied: stake_pool (owner), token (pool mint), admin/manager (manager account), staker (staker account), other (deposit authority, withdraw authority, fee account, reserve stake, validator list). All actor_class values set to 'unknown' as bytecode was not read — these are Solana accounts, not EVM contracts; the SPL program handles logic.

All 9 addresses in admin_addresses[] trace directly to the Solana Compass stake-pool statistics page fetch (evidence index 3). The alternative token mint jag58eRBC1c88LaAsRPspTMvoKJPbnzw9p9fREzHqyV traces to the Solflare search result (evidence index 2) — recorded in unknowns[] pending on-chain resolution.

rationale.verdict: Discovery run walked jagpool.xyz (website), docs.jagpool.xyz (docs), solanacompass.com/stake-pools/jagPCXWPBwoah9K4PxzHoh8z7aSru4Vbxq7GKUeEzgY (third-party on-chain data), solscan.io (block explorer), and spl.solana.com (program audit registry). Nine on-chain accounts catalogued. No JagPool-specific GitHub or protocol-owned audit reports found. One token-mint address discrepancy flagged for downstream verification.

protocol_metadata.about: JagPool is a Solana liquid staking protocol that allows SOL holders to delegate their tokens to a pool, receiving jagSOL tokens representing their proportional share of accrued staking rewards. The protocol focuses on geographic decentralization by directing stake to professional validators in Latin America (LATAM), APAC, and South Africa. JagPool uses the audited Solana SPL stake pool program (SPoo1Ku8WFXoNDMHPsrGSTSG1Y47rzgn41SLUNakuHy) for all fund operations, and charges a 5% rewards fee reinvested into ecosystem development. Users can unstake at the end of any epoch to redeem jagSOL for SOL plus accumulated rewards.
